Type: rug
Name: Stone & Beam Mid-Century Modern Blooming Medallion Rug, 4' x 6', Dark Grey
Colors: Dark Grey
Materials: stone
Pile: 100% Polypropylene, Backing: 100% Jute Imported This dark grey blooming medallion rug adds cool, contemporary style to your transitional spaces. It's a modern remake of a classic oriental pattern made of stain resistant fiber that is a smart option for active households. Highly durable update of a classic design Machine woven. Made in Turkey. 100% polypropylene Durable and long-lasting 4' x 6' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow up to a week for synthetic fibers to settle.
